Name: MENU_OFFSCR_REND_PARAM_ST
Description: Camera and lighting for the menu's off-screen model renders, such as the AC preview. A row can redirect to other rows for tetrapod and tank legs.

Fields.Name: Gaze Point: X
Fields.Description: The camera gaze point's position on the x-axis.

Fields.Name: Gaze Point: Y
Fields.Description: The camera gaze point's position on the y-axis.

Fields.Name: Gaze Point: Z
Fields.Description: The camera gaze point's position on the z-axis.

Fields.Name: Distance
Fields.Description: Distance from the camera to the gaze point, in metres.

Fields.Name: Rotation: X
Fields.Description: The camera's rotation on the x-axis.

Fields.Name: Rotation: Y
Fields.Description: The camera's rotation on the y-axis.

Fields.Name: Field of View
Fields.Description: The field of view of the camera.

Fields.Name: Minimum Distance
Fields.Description: Closest distance the player can move the camera to, in metres.

Fields.Name: Maximum Distance
Fields.Description: Farthest distance the player can move the camera to, in metres.

Fields.Name: Minimum Rotation: X
Fields.Description: Minimum x-axis rotation the player can turn the camera to.

Fields.Name: Maximum Rotation: X
Fields.Description: Maximum x-axis rotation the player can turn the camera to.

Fields.Name: GParam ID
Fields.Description: GPARAM set used to light this render.

Fields.Name: Offset: X
Fields.Description: Camera offset along the x-axis, as a fraction of the screen (0.5 shifts the view by half the screen).

Fields.Name: Offset: Y
Fields.Description: Camera offset along the y-axis, as a fraction of the screen (0.5 shifts the view by half the screen).

Fields.Name: Offset: Z
Fields.Description: Offset of the camera position along the z-axis, in metres.

Fields.Name: Referenced Dummy Polygon ID
Fields.Description: If set, the gaze point and camera direction are calculated from this dummy poly.

Fields.Name: Look at Booster Model
Fields.Description: If ON, the gaze point is calculated automatically so the camera looks at the booster model instead of the core.

Fields.Name: Use Hand Height for Gaze Point
Fields.Description: If ON, the gaze point uses the hand height instead of the core height.

Fields.Name: Mission Location Icon: Dummy Polygon ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly at which the icon marking the mission location is shown.

Fields.Name: Reference ID for Tetrapod
Fields.Description: The MenuOffscrRendParam row to use instead when the AC has tetrapod legs.

Fields.Name: Reference ID for Treads
Fields.Description: The MenuOffscrRendParam row to use instead when the AC has tank legs.
